reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 AI editorial review of 40 noun exercises: checked each full German sentence, case and number, all distractors, unique offered answer, bilingual instructions/hints/explanations and distinct contexts. Reviewed pinned source labels and production/initial/B2/workplace/general-expansion objectives; no identical noun-specific target mapped. Inherited gloss, plural and sense corrections documented per row. Human linguistic, CEFR, rights and publication review pending. Second editorial pass repaired an unnatural Empfang sentence and corrected a physics error confusing electrical energy with power. Recomputed every source-row SHA-256 using the exact parsed JSON record.
